entry.name: jit.world
entry.description: The jit.world object encapsulates the functionality of several jitter objects, including jit.window, jit.gl.render, jit.gl.node, jit.gl.cornerpin and jit.phys.world. Physics and GL objects are automatically added to the jit.world context and video objects have their automatic output enabled, when in the same patch.

attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: auto_handle
attributes.description: Enables the auto-handle transform gizmo mode (default = 0). The transform mode defaults to rotation, and changes to translate or scale via command and option modifiers. Shift modifier toggles between local and world axes.

attributes.name: border
attributes.description: Show window border (default = 1).

attributes.name: capture
attributes.description: Capture to the internal texture (default = 0). When enabled, all rendering is captured to texture and the texture name is output out the left outlet. The texture is also drawn to the internalfor display on the window. Synonym for.

attributes.name: depth_sort
attributes.description: Enables depth sorting mode (default = 0). When enabled, objects are sorted by distance from the camera prior to rendering each frame.

attributes.name: dim
attributes.description: Internal texture dimensions (default = 640 x 480). This attribute is set only if the desired texture output dimensions should differ from the window. If no arguments are given, the texture dimensions will adapt to the window size.

attributes.name: displaylink
attributes.description: Enable render draw sync to display swap (default = 1) (Mac only). When enabled, render draw calls are synced to the display swap.

attributes.name: drawbang
attributes.description: The draw bang output timing (default = prerender). Determines if the middle-outlet draw bang happens before or after rendering.

attributes.name: drawto
attributes.description: The internalcontext name (default = UID).drawto is the parent context of the internalsub-context.

attributes.name: enable
attributes.description: Enable automatic rendering (default = 0). When enabled, rendering is performed automatically.

attributes.name: enable_cornerpin
attributes.description: Enable the internalobject (default = 0). When enabled the cornerpin's handles are visible, and mouse handler is enabled. Enabling also setsto 1. Attributes and messages of the cornerpin can be sent using.

attributes.name: erase_color
attributes.description: Background and clear color as RGBA values (default = 0.2 0.2 0.2 1.0).

attributes.name: esc_fullscreen
attributes.description: When enabled, the escape key sends the window to fullscreen (default = 1).

attributes.name: fixed_delta
attributes.digest: Lock animation objects to a fixed rate
attributes.description: Locks the delta time value used by animation objects, in seconds (default = 0). When non-zero, animating objects will calculate updates using this value, rather than the actual time between frames. Useful for non realtime frame capture.
